logoDonts: Don't stretch, squash, rotate or crop the logo
Don't change the logo colours or add gradients
Don't add shadows, outlines or other effects
Don't place the logo on busy backgrounds where it's hard to read
Don't recreate or retype the logo
logoDos: Use the original approved files from this library
Leave clear space around the logo on all sides
Use the full-colour logo on Off White or light backgrounds
Use a white (Off White) logo on Site Green, Charcoal or dark photography
Use SVG for web and PDF for print suppliers
settings/guidelines.logoIntro: These are starter rules for using the AMB logo. An administrator should replace them with the rules from the official AMB brand guidelines and mark them Approved.

settings/naming.dateRules:
Use a date only when it helps: campaigns, events, annual brochures and price lists.
YYYY for annual material (2026).
YYYYMM for monthly campaigns (202611).
YYYYMMDD for one-off events or time-sensitive posts (20261123).
Never use DD-MM-YYYY, slashes or written months.
donts: Don't use spaces, hyphens or special characters (& # % ( ) !)
Don't use words like Final, New, Latest or Copy. Use the version number
Don't invent new category codes. Ask an administrator to add one
Don't rename approved files after download and re-share them
dos: Use PascalCase inside segments: CompanyProfile, not company profile
Use the approved category and platform codes
Write dimensions as width x height with a lower-case x: 1080x1080

segments.name: Prefix
segments.rule: Always “AMB” so files are identifiable outside the library.

segments.name: Category
segments.rule: An approved category code from the list below.

segments.name: AssetName
segments.rule: What the asset is, in PascalCase. No spaces or symbols.

segments.name: Platform
segments.rule: Where it will be used. Optional for general assets.

segments.name: Size
segments.rule: Pixel dimensions (W x H, lower-case x) or a paper size like A4. Optional.

segments.name: Version
segments.rule: Upper-case V and two digits. Increase for every approved change.

segments.name: Date
segments.rule: Year (YYYY), or YYYYMM / YYYYMMDD for time-sensitive campaigns. Optional.

settings/naming.versionRules:
Every new file starts at V01.
Increase the version (V02, V03…) every time an approved file changes, even slightly.
Never overwrite an approved file with a different design under the same version number.
Only the latest approved version should be used. Older versions stay in the library's version history and are archived when no longer needed.
Drafts in progress stay on your own computer or project folder until they're ready for review.
